name: Kiliseburnu Tunnel
facts: Kiliseburnu Tunnel, a twin‑tube marvel, stretches 200 and 195 meters, carrying two lanes in each direction and flanked by the 367‑meter Arıdurak Tunnel to the west and the 2,175‑meter Tirebolu‑1 Tunnel to the east.
Opened on April 7, 2007, the tunnel welcomed its first cars when Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan himself cut the ceremonial ribbon, marking a milestone for the Black Sea Coastal Highway.
Built by the Turkish Projima Tunnel Construction Company, Kiliseburnu Tunnel is part of the D.010 E70 corridor, linking Giresun Province to the broader national highway network.
